macros.name: currentfloat
macros.doc: This sets the trial float parameter values to those currently set in the document, or makes a guesstimate where the value is hard-coded.

macros.name: currentfloatpage
macros.doc: Sets the floatpage parameter trial values to those in the current document, or makes a guesstimate when these are hard-coded.

macros.name: currentheading
macros.doc: This routine sets the trial heading parameters to some predefined values that, hopefully, are reasonably representative.

macros.name: currentlist
macros.doc: This routine sets the trial list parameters to be those of the current list environment.

macros.name: currentparagraph
macros.doc: This routine sets the trial paragraph parameters to be those specified for the current document.

macros.name: currentstock
macros.doc: This routine sets the stock layout page parameters to those specified for the document.

macros.name: currenttoc
macros.doc: This routine sets the trial ToC parameters to those specified for the current document.

macros.name: drawfloat
macros.doc: The command to draw the picture of float parameters.

macros.name: drawfloatpage
macros.doc: The command to draw a picture of the float page layout and parameters.

macros.name: drawfontframe
macros.doc: Draws a tightly fitting box with the text reference point marked and a dotted line along the baseline.

macros.name: drawfontframelabel
macros.doc: Draws a tightly fitting box with the text reference point marked and a dotted line along the baseline and marks the width, height and depth.

macros.name: drawfootnote
macros.doc: This routine draws the layout of a footnote.

macros.name: drawheading
macros.doc: This routine draws the layout of a sectional heading.

macros.name: drawlist
macros.doc: This routine draws the layout of a list environment.

macros.name: drawpage
macros.doc: This routine draws a page layout.

macros.name: drawparagraph
macros.doc: This routine draws the layout of a paragraph.

macros.name: drawstock
macros.doc: This routine draws a stock page layout.

macros.name: drawtoc
macros.doc: The command to draw the layout of a ToC entry.

macros.name: floatvalues

macros.name: printinunitsof
macros.doc: \printinunitsof{⟨unit⟩} sets \l@yunits to the value of ⟨unit⟩ and \l@yunitperpt to the number of ⟨unit⟩ in 1pt.

macros.name: prntlen
macros.doc: \prntlen{⟨length⟩} prints the value of ⟨length⟩ in the units set by \printinunitsof.

macros.name: setfootbox
macros.doc: Sets the height and depth of the footer box and stores the results in \l@youtvdv and \l@youtvdvi.

macros.name: setlabelfont
